verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, a professional-services business rather than a software platform. Subscribing to events via programmatic webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any webhook capability: its site offers an llms.txt index and content pages, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
